resources.name: Nullmagic
resources.description: Nullmagic points equal half Antipaladin level plus Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), refresh after 8 hours, and pay for Disrupt, Counterspell, the bastion, and nullshaping techniques.

choice_providers.label: Nullshaping Techniques

fixed_options.name: Counterspell
fixed_options.description: Gain a qualifying counterspell feat; may be selected more than once from 6th level.

fixed_options.name: Cleanse
fixed_options.description: From 9th level, counterspell a qualifying effect on yourself as a free action once per turn.

fixed_options.name: Expanded Nullmagic
fixed_options.description: Increase the nullmagic pool by 3; this technique stacks.

fixed_options.name: Mageguard Training
fixed_options.description: Gain Disruptive and later Spellbreaker without their normal prerequisites.

fixed_options.name: Nullmagic Glide
fixed_options.description: Spend nullmagic while moving to pass through movement-restricting magic.

fixed_options.name: Nullmagic Shell
fixed_options.description: Spend nullmagic for short-lived DR and energy resistance against magical or supernatural sources.

fixed_options.name: Nullmagic Shutdown
fixed_options.description: From 14th level, spend nullmagic to become untargetable by creature-targeting spell effects for a short duration.

fixed_options.name: Pacified Disruption
fixed_options.description: Designated allies may use items you have disrupted.

fixed_options.name: Permit Assistance
fixed_options.description: Voluntarily allow helpful magic to bypass your spell resistance or immunity.

fixed_options.name: Physical Training
fixed_options.description: Gain two combat talents; may be selected a second time from 12th level.

fixed_options.name: Rites Against Conjurations
fixed_options.description: Spend nullmagic to ward yourself against contact by summoned creatures.

choice_providers.description: Choose one technique at 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter. Technique prerequisites remain visible in their descriptions.

resources.name: Smite
resources.description: One use at 1st level plus one at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter. The selected pledge alignment determines valid adversaries.

resources.name: Divine Touch
resources.description: Daily uses equal half class level plus casting ability modifier. The pledge alignment determines the touch effect.

resources.name: Channel Divinity
resources.description: Each use spends two Divine Touch uses; the pledge alignment determines the channel effect.

choice_providers.label: Pledge Alignment
choice_providers.description: Choose an alignment the Avowed possesses; it controls Smite, Divine Touch, Channel Divinity, and pledge abilities.

choice_providers.label: Avowed Pledge
choice_providers.description: The pledge grants its class skill and level 3, 6, 8, and 20 abilities.

fixed_options.name: Spiritual Armament
fixed_options.description: Enhance a chosen weapon, armor, or shield.

fixed_options.name: Spiritual Ally
fixed_options.description: Gain an intelligent animal companion using full Avowed level.

fixed_options.name: Incarnation Form
fixed_options.description: Gain the Alteration sphere and a deity-linked incarnation trait.

fixed_options.name: Divine Herald
fixed_options.description: Gain a Bound Creature herald whose Conjuration statistics use class level as caster level.

choice_providers.label: Condemnations
choice_providers.description: Choose one condemnation at 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter. One may be added to an attack action by spending a spell point or martial focus.

resources.name: Mutagen
resources.description: Prepare one mutagen using Brawler level as Alchemist level. Choose the enhanced physical ability when activating it; Greater Mutagen unlocks at 12th level.

resources.name: Sneak Attack Applies
resources.description: Toggle when the target is flanked or denied Dexterity to AC. Damage advances at Brawler levels 1, 6, 10, 12, and 20.

resources.name: Strangle Damage Applies
resources.description: Toggle after a successful grapple check to damage or pin. Strangle damage advances at levels 1, 2, 8, and 15.

entries.choice_handling_note: The Wild Child companion uses full Brawler level as effective Druid level. Exchanged bonus-feat slots are removed by the shared advancement resolver.

fixed_options.name: Mystery of Unblinking Flame
fixed_options.description: Enhancement speed, grapple fire, and liquid-flame escape abilities.

fixed_options.name: Mystery of Unfolding Wind
fixed_options.description: Longer range increments, Deflect Arrows, supernatural leaps, and projectile redirection.

fixed_options.name: Mystery of Untwisting Iron
fixed_options.description: Masterwork metal gear, metal crafting benefits, and adamantine attacks.

choice_providers.label: Prescient Combat Sphere

fixed_options.name: Boxing
fixed_options.description: Gain Boxing as the bonus combat sphere; unlocks Patience portent strikes.

fixed_options.name: Open Hand
fixed_options.description: Gain Open Hand as the bonus combat sphere; unlocks Finesse portent strikes.

choice_providers.description: Divination must be the first magic sphere. Choose Boxing or Open Hand as the bonus combat sphere.

choice_providers.label: Technical Combinations
choice_providers.description: Choose two combinations at 4th level and another every 4 levels thereafter. Selections may change when gizmos are maintained each day.
